description: TEACHES relationships connecting CCC paragraphs to Types they discuss

teaches.notes: Explains the allegorical sense using Red Sea as example
Defines typology as discerning prefigurations of Christ
Explains typological reading in light of Christ
Typology indicates dynamic movement toward fulfillment
Core typology teaching listing multiple type/antitype pairs
OT covenant signs prefigure NT sacraments
Red Sea crossing as liberation prefiguring baptism
Jordan crossing prefigures baptism; the promised land is an image of eternal life
Melchizedek's bread and wine, a prefiguring of the Church's offering
OT bread/wine offerings, the manna and the Passover prefigure the Eucharist
OT priesthood and Melchizedek prefigure Christ's priesthood
The mission of the holy women of the Old Covenant prepared for that of Mary
Mary is the ark of the covenant, the place where the glory of the Lord dwells
